decisions.lib.rs: open() makes one connector.connect() per request, with no retry; a failed dial is CONNECTION_REFUSED

apple_shutdown.method: Read through a fetch on 2026-11-22 from branch main. The fetch kept no bytes, so no digest exists. The guest build is not pinned to this revision.
apple_shutdown.decisions: The now path skips the fork, prints Shutdown NOW! and System shutdown time has arrived with two BEL characters, calls reboot3, and reaches finish(0), exit 0, if that call returns. A failed reserve_reboot exits 0 through finish(0) after the first line only.
